post.description: Public: no authentication required. Creates the account and logs the user in.
Public: no authentication required. Starts a new session for the account.
Ends only the session of the cookie that was sent.

delete.description: Deletes the account (soft delete) and logs out every device. Requires login, not consent.

post.description: Records consent to storing health data. Requires login, not consent.
Records that the first-run introduction was closed. Requires login, not consent.

get.description: The user's profile and stored daily target; 404 `profile_not_found` before setup.

put.description: Create or replace the profile; the target is recomputed and stored on every save.

get.description: Shared items plus the user's own whose name contains `q`; max 20; `[]` under 2 chars.

post.description: Register the user's own food item (`source="user"`); only its owner can see it.

get.description:
The user's 10 most recently logged distinct items, newest first (by entry `date`,
then `created_at`), each with the last grams and Meal.

Find a food by EAN-8/13: the user's own items, then shared items, then Open Food
Facts (a found product is cached as a shared item). Only called on submit.
The user's entries for one date (YYYY-MM-DD) by Meal, with Meal and day totals.

post.description: Log grams of a food item in a Meal; kcal per 100 g is copied as a snapshot.

patch.description: Change grams and/or Meal of the user's entry; the date and kcal snapshot never change.

delete.description: Delete the user's entry at once; it can be restored for 10 minutes.

post.description: Undo a delete made within the last 10 minutes ("Angre"); otherwise 404.

get.description: The nine equipment types in seed order.

Exercises whose required equipment is all in the user's chosen Equipment Profile,
ordered Nybegynner, Middels, Øvet. Another user's profile, or an id that is unknown or
not a UUID, is 404 `equipment_profile_not_found`.

The user's Equipment Profiles in creation order. A user with none (registered before
profiles existed) gets "Hjemme" and "Treningssenter" first.

post.description: New profile; Kroppsvekt is always included. At most 10 profiles, names unique.

patch.description: Rename and/or replace the equipment of the user's profile; Kroppsvekt is kept.

delete.description: Delete the user's profile; the last one cannot be deleted.

get.description: All exercises, ordered by primary muscle group, then name.

One exercise with muscle groups, equipment, technique steps and video id. An id that
is unknown or not a UUID is 404 `exercise_not_found`.

EquipmentProfileCreate.title: EquipmentProfileCreate
EquipmentProfileCreate.description: A new profile. `kroppsvekt` is always added by the server, whatever is sent.

EquipmentProfileUpdate.title: EquipmentProfileUpdate
EquipmentProfileUpdate.description:
Rename and/or replace the equipment. Left out or null means unchanged; `kroppsvekt`
is always kept.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One invalid input field, shown inline under that field in the UI.

FoodEntryUpdate.title: FoodEntryUpdate
FoodEntryUpdate.description:
Change grams and/or Meal of an entry (story 3.6). Left out or null means unchanged;
the item, date and kcal snapshot can never be changed (AD-6).

FoodItemCreate.title: FoodItemCreate
FoodItemCreate.description:
A user's own food item. `source` and `owner_id` are set by the server; extra keys
such as those are ignored (AD-4).

RecentFoodResponse.title: RecentFoodResponse
RecentFoodResponse.description: A food item the user logged before, with the amount and Meal of its latest entry.

SuggestionsResponse.title: SuggestionsResponse
SuggestionsResponse.description:
Exercises that fit one Equipment Profile (story 4.3), ordered Nybegynner, Middels,
Øvet, then muscle group, then name.
